title: 第25章 一阶丧尸第26章 地下停车场
slug: 永恒降临全民开局末世求生
content_zh:
在苏墨之后，赵敢当、苏婷、严梅三人也陆续被虫洞给吐了出来。
苏墨从地上坐起，满身都是一种透明的粘液，粘液无毒无害无污染，只要过一分钟就会自行消散。
几人也陆续坐起，在穿过虫洞时并不会昏迷，只是会觉得有些头晕，感觉自然不会太好，毕竟虫洞内部全是粘液。
“啊啊啊，好恶心啊。”
严梅慌张的从地上站起来，尝试刮掉手上的粘液。
苏婷也是一脸嫌弃的样子，正常来说，不会有谁会喜欢跳虫洞的过程。
查看地图，虫洞的这个点距离庇护所更远了，目测都快横跨一个省了。
苏墨的庇护所在地是华国原来的江柘省，江城算是一个沿海城市，起源庇护所位于东侧，可惜还没有把海岸线给探出来。
昨天是向偏北方进入的沼泽区，还有一大半的沼泽区没探完，只是从中心线穿过，可以大致预估即可。
一分钟很快就过去了，身上的粘液虽然消失了，但二女还是感觉十分不适，这种不适是心理上的不适，相当于有人把芦荟胶装作鼻涕弄在你的身上，事后解释这不是鼻涕，但你如果不去洗手，你就会感觉很变扭。
看来今天不洗一个澡是不行的了，就连苏墨也是想冲洗一番，不管怎么说，没必要委屈自己。
看地面能知道这里是一片草原，除了草丛一眼望去就看不到什么东西了，四人又开始分散探图。
苏墨向北没有发现什么东西，都是其他人的几处地点发现了不同的东西，赵敢当的南方发现了一大群牛，严梅的西边发现了一处废弃的建筑，苏婷那边更是有蛆虫存在。
先去严梅那边，今晚估计就要在那所建筑内过夜，在群内发了条消息，去严梅那边集合，随后就往那边赶去。
苏墨是最慢的一个，他平时也带着魔光护符，这样赶路速度快，集合的时间自然就拉长了，远远看见三人呆立在远处。
走近后，苏墨便知道赵敢当他们为什么一直抬头望天，前方的建筑是一座商厦，左边被削掉了一个角，仿佛是被一剑给削平的，切面平整光滑。
整座商厦显得死气沉沉，外面的墙体还有不少干涸的血迹，几具骷髅骨架躺在一旁的地面上，骨架边还有一些物资。
人是万物之灵，被「永恒领域」赋予半数据化之后，如果死亡，身上储物栏的物品全会掉落在地上，身体也会化为骷髅骨架，跟苏墨下洞时遇见的一模一样。
其余生物死亡之后，都是爆素材，不过当生物的智慧能够有效地思考时，便会有一次判定的机会，成功之后，也会被「永恒领域」赋予面板，相当于半数据化。
“看样子这里曾经聚集着一大批人啊，不知道还有没有活下来的。”

略微分析，苏墨就知道发生了什么事情。
“敢当你走前面，苏婷和严梅居中，我垫后，小心危险。”
赵敢当直接就往前走，严梅有些害怕，“就，就不能不去吗，或者我和婷姐待着原地等你们。”
苏墨瞥了一眼严梅，吓得她直往苏婷身后躲，苏婷出来缓解气氛。
“小梅，首先我们都是起源庇护所的一员，自然要听领主的，其次，如果我们待在原地发生了危险，敢当小弟和苏领主也来不及保护我们。”
严梅点点头，走到了赵敢当的身后，一行人慢慢的朝着商厦内前进。
因为修行了《虚空炼神法》的原因，处于感知境界的神魂，能感觉到暗中有目光在若有若无地窥探着他们，但难以分辨是哪里传来的目光。
接近这堆尸骸，苏墨将散落的东西全都捡起来，也没有什么有用的东西，无非是一些草、树枝和腐烂物，捡起便携随身箱。
【不可携带他人的随身箱，是否吸收便携随身箱，若选择吸收，你的随身箱格子+1。
苏墨的随身箱格子只有16格，在连续吸收了9个随身箱之后，箱子的外观也发生了变化。
content_en:
After Su Mo, Zhao Gandang, Su Ting, and Yan Mei were also spit out by the wormhole one after another.
Su Mo sat up from the ground. His whole body was covered with a kind of transparent mucus. The mucus was non-toxic, harmless and pollution-free. It would dissipate on its own after a minute.
Several people also sat up one after another. They would not be unconscious when they passed through the wormhole, but they would feel a little dizzy. Naturally, they would not feel too good. After all, the inside of the wormhole was full of mucus.
"Ahhh, that's so disgusting."
Yan Mei stood up from the ground in a panic and tried to scrape the mucus off her hands.
Su Ting also looked disgusted. Normally, no one would like the process of jumping into a wormhole.
Looking at the map, this point of the wormhole is further away from the shelter, almost spanning a province by visual inspection.
Su Mo's shelter is located in the original Jiangzhe Province of China. Jiangcheng is a coastal city. The original shelter is located on the east side. Unfortunately, the coastline has not been explored yet.
Yesterday we entered the swamp area from the north. There is still more than half of the swamp area that has not been explored. We only passed through the center line, so we can roughly estimate it.
A minute passed quickly. Although the mucus on their bodies disappeared, the two women still felt very uncomfortable. This discomfort was psychological discomfort, equivalent to someone putting aloe vera gel on your body pretending to be snot. Afterwards, you explained that it was not snot, but if you don't wash your hands, you will feel very twisted.
It seemed that it was impossible not to take a shower today. Even Su Mo wanted to take a shower. Anyway, there was no need to wrong himself.
Looking at the ground, you can tell that this is a grassland. Apart from the grass, nothing can be seen at a glance. The four of them began to disperse and explore the map again.
Su Mo didn't find anything to the north. Other people found different things in several locations. Zhao Gandang found a large herd of cattle to the south, Yan Mei found an abandoned building to the west, and there were maggots over Su Ting.
Let's go to Yan Mei's place first. We will probably spend the night in that building tonight. I sent a message to the group to meet up at Yan Mei's place, and then rushed there.
Su Mo is the slowest one. He usually carries a magic light amulet. This way he can travel quickly and the gathering time will naturally be lengthened. From a distance, he saw the three of them standing blankly in the distance.
After getting closer, Su Mo knew why Zhao Gandang and the others kept looking up at the sky. The building in front of them was a commercial building. A corner was cut off on the left side, as if it had been flattened by a sword. The cut surface was flat and smooth.
The entire commercial building looked lifeless, with a lot of dried blood stains on the walls outside. Several skeletons were lying on the ground beside them, and there were some supplies beside the skeletons.
Man is the spirit of all things. After being given semi-digitalization by the "Eternal Realm", if he dies, all the items in his storage box will fall to the ground, and his body will turn into a skeleton, exactly the same as what Su Mo encountered when he went down the cave.
After the death of other creatures, they are all explosive materials. However, when the intelligence of the creature can think effectively, there will be a chance to judge. After success, it will also be given a panel by the "Eternal Realm", which is equivalent to semi-digitalization.
"It seems that a large number of people once gathered here. I wonder if anyone survived."
After a little analysis, Su Mo knew what happened.
"If you dare to go in front, Su Ting and Yan Mei will be in the middle. I will take the back. Be careful of danger."
Zhao Gandang walked forward directly. Yan Mei was a little scared, "Just, can't we not go? Or Sister Ting and I will stay where we are and wait for you."
Su Mo glanced at Yan Mei and was so frightened that she hid behind Su Ting. Su Ting came out to ease the atmosphere.
"Xiaomei, first of all, we are all members of the Origin Sanctuary, so we naturally have to listen to the lord. Secondly, if we stay where we are and are in danger, my younger brother and Lord Su will not be able to protect us in time."
Yan Mei nodded, walked behind Zhao Gandang, and the group slowly moved towards the commercial building.
Because of practicing the "Void God Refining Method", I am in a state of emotional distress.Souls who know the realm can feel that there are eyes in the dark spying on them, but it is difficult to tell where the eyes are coming from.
Approaching the pile of corpses, Su Mo picked up all the scattered things. There was nothing useful, just some grass, branches and rotten objects. He picked up the portable suitcase.
[You cannot carry other people's carry-on bags. Whether to absorb the portable carry-on box. If you choose to absorb it, your carry-on box grid will be +1.
Su Mo's carry-on box has only 16 grids. After absorbing 9 carry-on boxes in a row, the appearance of the box has also changed.
